docs.title: Q3 Product Strategy — Data Out & Onboarding
docs.snippet: Two bets: (1) Data Out — exports, read API, webhooks; directly defends $1.1M of enterprise ARR at renewal risk. (2) First-Five-Minutes — cut time-to-first-dashboard from 26m to <5m; activation (D7 dashboard created) is the strongest retention predictor we have (r=0.61).

docs.title: PRD: Scheduled Exports (LUM-341)
docs.snippet: Scope: per-dashboard schedule (daily/weekly), destinations email + S3, formats CSV first then Parquet (LUM-371). Out of scope: row-level transforms. Success: 30% of enterprise workspaces with an active schedule within 60 days. Open: encryption-at-destination requirements for healthcare customers.

docs.title: Research: Onboarding drop-off study (n=212)
docs.snippet: 62% of new workspaces never create a dashboard. Biggest stall: post-connection empty state ('what now?'). Users who apply a template in session 1 activate at 3.4x the rate. Auto-schema detection rated 'very useful' by 81% of interviewees.

docs.title: Postmortem INC-88: ingestion lag
docs.snippet: Backfill job starved the consumer pool for 40 minutes. Root cause: shared queue. Action items: separate backfill queue (open), per-tenant fairness caps (open), alert on consumer lag >5m (done).

docs.title: Engineering: API design principles
docs.snippet: Versioned from day one. Cursor pagination everywhere. Rate limits are product features — expose them in headers. No breaking changes inside a major version, ever. Errors follow problem+json.
